photos.desc: Cucurbita pepo, Hortus botanicus Leiden, Netherlands
Abobrinha (Cucurbita pepo L.) var. hibrida Clarinda / Fruto

Accidental hybrid of acorn squash and another variety of Cucurbita pepo, probably dark green zucchini, variety "Black Beauty." The flesh is rather stringy. It tastes like acorn squash. The mature skin
